cut.description: Whether the next line stops a voice still playing. The default is true; false lets it finish.

x-contract.zero: v1 keeps 0; v0 has per-field rules
x-contract.version: 0, 1, 2 (omitting it and writing 0 differ in v0)

skip.description: Whether skip mode passes the wait. The default is true.

WaitCue.description: A pause, written as seconds or a map (the map needs schema version 4).

description: The YAML types of a Gozen game. gozen check is the authority on ranges, references and the meaning of expressions.
